description: The prose the player reads, split into narration and dialogue.

lines.description: All narration and dialogue, in order.

speaker_id.description: Exact id of the speaker. Null for narration or an unlisted speaker.

unlisted_speaker.description: Only with a null speaker_id: a short description of an unlisted passer-by who speaks, such as Fish vendor. Never a proper name. Empty for narration.

text.description: One passage of narration, or only what the speaker says.
